output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner public {                balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount;                totalSupply += mintedAmount;                Transfer(0, this, mintedAmount);                Transfer(this, target, mintedAmount);            }            }
output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to mint more tokens than the total supply. This will cause the total supply to exceed the initial supply and devalue the token. The tokens minted by the owner should not exceed the initial supply.
